title: PR #219: [DRAFT] Add exact-SHA per-file function and purpose census
content:
State: open
Merged: False
Draft: True

## Summary

Adds a machine-readable, exact-SHA per-file purpose inventory to the existing organization source-census workflow. This extends the existing census/catalog governance; it does not create a competing capability registry.

## Included

- `tools/build_org_file_function_catalog.py`: emits `ATC-ORG-FILE-FUNCTION-CATALOG-001` JSON for every tracked file in each available clean repository checkout, not only recognized source extensions.
- Each file entry records repository/source SHA, path, Git blob SHA, SHA-256, size, role, purpose, purpose basis/confidence, candidate public symbols where available, and explicit `DISCOVERY_ONLY` / `NOT_PERFORMED` status.
- Documented purpose is preferred; fallback purpose is explicitly marked low-confidence heuristic.
- Workflow clone set includes public archived repositories as historical references; private repositories without access are explicit exclusions.
- Unit tests cover provenance, per-file coverage, purpose confidence, and fail-closed missing checkouts.
- JSON output is uploaded as a workflow artifact alongside the existing census and reconciliation evidence.

## Governance and limitations

- No existing catalog entries are overwritten; no canonical ownership is inferred from mirrored umbrella-repository copies.
- Lexical symbols and inferred file purposes are not functional verification.
- Missing/dirty/SHA-mismatched repositories block the per-file catalog.
- No merge requested; this PR remains Draft until exact-head CI and artifact coverage are reviewed.
